ns2:course.label: Advanced Accompanying
ns2:course.description: Principles of accompanying singers and instrumentalists, practical experience in accompanying, and facility in sight reading for keyboard performers. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
